title: Anonymous USAF colonel and fighter pilot's UFO encounter

tellings.quote: he had a really dramatic UFO encounter in 1980 or something like that.

plain: An unnamed US Air Force colonel and fighter pilot is said to have had a dramatic UFO encounter around 1980. A guest named James Fox tells Michels about the man second-hand, saying "he had a really dramatic UFO encounter in 1980 or something like that," without giving his name, where it happened or what he saw. If true, it would add a senior military pilot to the list of trained witnesses.
